description: Current odds for one football match: home win, draw and away win as implied probabilities and decimal odds from a real-money prediction market, with kickoff time (UTC), venue when known, status, live score while in play, the result once finished, recent form and the match page link. Pass match_id from find_matches, or just a team name to get that team's next match. Prices are live when the market's feed answers (prices_live).

match_id.description: The match: an id from find_matches, list_futures or get_market, or a frontofgoal.com page URL.

team.description: Instead of match_id: a team name, to get that team's next match.

name: get_match_odds

home.description: Last five results, W/D/L, latest last.

minute.description: Match minute while in play, when known.

note.description: Caveats about the prices or status.

best_ask.description: Lowest price someone will sell at now, 0 to 1.

best_bid.description: Highest price someone will pay now, 0 to 1.

probability.description: Implied probability from the market price, 0 to 1.

quoted.description: True when both a bid and an ask are standing, so the price is live.

prices_live.description: True when the prices were read live for this answer.

result.description: home, draw or away once settled.

score.description: Score as home-away while in play or after the match, when known.

status.description: scheduled, in_play, finished, awaiting_result, postponed, cancelled, abandoned or suspended.

traded_30d_usd.description: US dollars traded on this match in the last 30 days.

title: Get match odds
